prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your industry, goals, budget, and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. Quick next steps:

1) Quick questions so I can shortlist agencies for you
- What type of marketing do you need most? (digital/SEO, paid ads, social, branding, PR, content, B2B demand gen, ecommerce, etc.)
- What’s your industry (healthcare, tech, real estate, nonprofit, retail, etc.)?
- What is your monthly/annual budget range?
- Do you need a local agency (Baltimore, Annapolis, Silver Spring) or is remote okay?
- Any must-have deliverables or timeline constraints?

2) How to evaluate agencies (use these when vetting)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (not just awards)
- Client references and retention rate
- Industry experience and similar clients
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and tools they use
- Team size and who will actually do the work
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Cultural fit and communication style

3) Where to find and compare agencies
- Review sites: Clutch.co, G2, UpCity
- Google Business reviews and LinkedIn company pages
- Local business publications and award lists (Baltimore Business Journal, Washington Business Journal)
- Recommendations in industry-specific communities

4) If you want, I can
- Provide a tailored shortlist of 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs, with pros/cons and estimated pricing
- Draft outreach/email template to send to agencies
- Suggest a vetting checklist and interview questions

Tell me the answers to the short questions above and I’ll build a targeted shortlist.
